subject: Re: Contoso - Partner Center referral mismatch / ownership dispute
body:
From: Megan Stone <megan.stone@contoso.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Contoso - Partner Center referral shows different seller owner

Hi Vanessa,

We just noticed a problem in Partner Center: a referral for our Contoso account (Customer ID: 998-442) is showing a Microsoft seller as the owner but our field rep was expecting Redwood's seller allocation. The attached account mapping shows the discrepancy — Contoso believes Redwood should own the referral for this expansion opportunity (see sheet 'expected-owners'). This is blocking our handoff to the field.

Can your team confirm who currently owns the referral and help escalate to Partner Center if needed? We're on a tight cadence for the pilot kickoff next week.

Thanks,
Megan Stone
Sr. Strategic Sourcing Manager
Contoso Ltd.
[Attachment: contoso_account_map.xlsx]

---

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Megan Stone <megan.stone@contoso.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contoso - Partner Center referral shows different seller owner

Thanks for the heads up, Megan — and sorry for the surprise. I pulled Karthik and Sean in to triage ownership and confirm the source of the mismatch.

Planned next steps (quick):
- Karthik: run an ownership history check (internal logs) to see if the referral was claimed by Redwood and when.
- Sean: if partner center shows an external owner, please open a Partner Center reconciliation ticket and forward the thread to PC support.
- Laura: please prepare the 1-pager for Contoso handoff (owner, next steps, expected timeline).

We'll circle back by EOD with either a reconciliation or an escalation ticket number.

Vanessa Ortiz
Head, Partner GTM | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: internal_owner_log.csv] (internal)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Aug 2027 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contoso - Partner Center referral shows different seller owner

Quick update from my side: I checked our internal ownership ledger and I see a claim was created on 2027-07-28 under opportunity D-95842 with an owner email of seller+redwood@redwood.com. However, Partner Center shows a different claimant (Dave Lin) after an automated reconcile on 2027-07-30. Attached is the snippet from our owner log.

If PC processed an automated ownership override (possible due to differing tenant match or MPN mapping), we need a formal reconcile request from PC. Sean — can you open that ticket and reference the Contoso mapping Megan shared?

Karthik
Senior Sales Ops | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: internal_owner_log.csv]

Hello Partner Center team,

Please see the attached: Contoso claims Redwood should own the referral for opportunity D-95842. Our internal ledger shows Redwood made a claim on 2027-07-28 but Partner Center reflects Dave Lin as owner after an automated reconcile dated 2027-07-30. Can you confirm the reason for the override and reassign ownership to Redwood if the claim is valid?

Attachments: contoso_account_map.xlsx, internal_owner_log.csv

[Attachment: pc-referral-email.eml]

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Partner Sales

From: PC Referrals <pc-referrals@microsoft.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Megan Stone <megan.stone@contoso.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contoso - Partner Center referral reconciliation (PC-112233)

Hi Sean / Redwood team,

Thanks for the details and attachments. We investigated ticket PC-112233 and can confirm the following:
- The referral was auto-assigned to Dave Lin (dave.lin@microsoft.com) due to an MPN tenant mapping conflict between Contoso's legacy tenant and the new tenant associated with the Redwood claim.
- We have updated the referral owner to the Redwood seller record (seller+redwood@redwood.com) after manual reconciliation.
- We also attached our reconciliation note to ticket PC-112233 and added a comment for Contoso's tenant admin to confirm tenant association to avoid future auto-overrides.

Partner Center link: https://partner.microsoft.com/en-US/support/ticket/PC-112233

Please let us know if you need a joint introduction to Dave Lin or additional evidence for procurement.

Regards,
PC Referrals Team
Partner Center Support

---

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Megan Stone <megan.stone@contoso.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 3 Aug 2027 15:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Contoso - Partner Center referral shows different seller owner

Hi Megan — good news: Partner Center completed a manual reconciliation and the referral owner is now set to our Redwood seller record. We've attached the PC ticket link above for your audit.

Next steps:
- Laura will coordinate a brief handoff call (15–20 mins) with the assigned Microsoft seller (Dave Lin), your Contoso procurement lead, and our CS lead to lock the pilot kickoff date.
- Karthik will update our internal opportunity D-95842 to reflect the corrected owner and confirm routing for any future referrals.
- I'll keep this thread open until the handoff call is complete.

Proposed times for the handoff call: Wed 08/04 10:00–10:30 PT or Thu 08/05 14:00–14:30 PT. Megan — please confirm what works for you and your procurement lead.

Thanks for raising this quickly — apologies for the noise.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head, Partner GTM | Redwood Inference
[Attachments referenced above: contoso_account_map.xlsx, internal_owner_log.csv, pc-referral-email.eml]
